Une action élargie pour la santé des fem: Expanded action for women's health in M’Sila
A l’occasion de la campagne internationa: On the occasion of the international awareness campaign dedicated to the fight against breast cancer, the company is expanding the geographical scope of its actions. Thanks to an established collaboration with the Hammadites clinic in M’Sila, a group of fifty women is benefiting from a fully covered screening pathway.
Ce dispositif sanitaire englobe des cons: This healthcare program includes gynecological consultations, breast ultrasound examinations, and mammograms, determined according to the medical needs of each beneficiary. This initiative aims to facilitate access to preventive examinations and encourage women to pay closer attention to their health, while marking a new step in the company's desire to extend its actions to different regions of the country.
Nadia Bourega, Digital Marketing & PR Sp: Nadia Bourega, Digital Marketing & PR Specialist at LG Electronics Algeria, states: « At LG Electronics Algeria, we consider awareness and prevention as essential levers in the fight against breast cancer. Our commitment on the occasion of Pink October is part of a continuous approach aimed at supporting concrete initiatives and contributing to collective efforts in favor of women's health. This year, our collaboration with the Hammadites clinic in M’Sila marks a new step in this approach, allowing us to extend our actions to other regions of the country and strengthen our proximity to local communities. »
LG Electronics Algérie participe à la ca: LG Electronics Algeria is participating in the Pink October campaign through a new initiative focused on breast cancer prevention.
Cinquante femmes de la wilaya de M'Sila: Fifty women from the wilaya of M'Sila are benefiting from comprehensive care including gynecological consultations, breast ultrasounds, and mammograms.
L'opération est menée en collaboration a: The operation is conducted in collaboration with the Hammadites clinic.
L'entreprise poursuit ainsi son objectif: The company thus pursues its objective of expanding the geographical scope of its health actions across the country.
